verdict.rationale: IP India runs online e-filing and public status-lookup services, so a programmatic API with scoped, least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only web e-filing, public search and status pages. Nothing in it mentions an API, API keys, tokens or permission scopes, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
